The Inherent Instability of the Dictatorship
FASCIST STATE
Fault Line 1:
Class Contradiction
The state cannot abolish classes.
The contrast between anti-
capitalist rhetoric and the violent
enrichment of the monopolist
bourgeoisie inevitably alienates
its mass base.
Fault Line 2:
Bourgeois Friction
Economic nationalism and
autarchy undermine the
economy, leading to sharp,
bloody collisions within the
ruling class itself (e.g., the June
30 purge in Germany).
Fault Line 3: Democratic
Disillusionment
By elevating open violence to a
system of government, fascism
destroys the illusion of peaceful
democracy, accidentally pushing
the working class toward
revolutionary consciousness.

Anatomy of a Preventable Disaster
Austria
Social Democrats held state
power and arsenals in 1918
but surrendered them. They
fooled workers with the
Linz program while leaving
the heroic Schutzbund
isolated during the decisive
February battles.
Germany
Social Democrats (Braun &
Severing) banned the Red
Front Fighters instead of
arming them alongside the
Reichsbanner. Meanwhile,
Communists underestimated
the danger, believing
"Germany is not Italy" and
failing to adapt to wounded
national sentiments
regarding Versailles.
Spain
Socialists in the bourgeois
government refused to
confiscate church/landlord
properties, failed to purge
monarchists from the army,
army, and shot peasants
fighting for land.

EVERY FACTORY, IN EVERY DISTRICT, IN EVERY
REGION, IN EVERY COUNTRY, ALL OVER THE WORLD.
THE ONLY CONDITION
The Communist International demands no ideological surrender. There is only one
elementary condition: Unity of action must be directed against fascism, against the
offensive of capital, and against the threat of war.

the
"Red danger'

The Rebuttal
Expose the maneuver by honestly participating. We
seek unity to build strength for defense today and
emancipation tomorrow.
The United Front threatens only the financial
magnates and exploiters who are currently ruining the
middle class.
Social-Democratic ministers in Germany, Austria, and
Spain did not prevent fascism from attacking the

GLOBAL EXECUTION: THE UNITED STATES
STRATEGIC ASSESSMENT
Embryonic fascism is masking itself as the
defender of the Constitution and American
democracy, preying on millions disillusioned
by the crisis and the collapse of capitalist
recovery programs.
THE DIRECTIVE
CREATE A MASS
WORKERS' AND
FARMERS' PARTY.
TACTICAL RULES
It must be explicitly anti-fascist, targeting banks,
trusts, and monopolies.
It must defend concrete needs: social legislation,
unemployment insurance, debt cancellation for
farmers, and equal status for Black sharecroppers.
Initiative must not fall to reactionary elements
trying to create an anti-Communist "third party".

GLOBAL EXECUTION:
GREAT BRITAIN
STRATEGIC ASSESSMENT:
The National Government is passing reactionary measures,
lowering living standards, and creating conditions that facilitate a
fascist transition, while Mosley's fascists wait in the wings.
THE DIRECTIVE:
Form a united front with trade unions and Labour Party branches
against the National Government.
THE NUANCE
SOVIET GOVERNANCE
Communists remain in favor of a
soviet government as the only form
capable of true emancipation.
TACTICAL SUPPORT
Recognizing the masses' desire for a
new Labor Government, Communists
will support this fight-provided they
present a joint program demanding the
defense of the essential economic and
political interests of the working class.

GLOBAL EXECUTION:
THE FRENCH BLUEPRINT
STRATEGIC ASSESSMENT
The French working class sets the
international example, mobilizing half a
million people in Paris. However, the
fascist Croix de Feu commands 300.000
armed men, backed by monopoly capital
and the Catholic Church.
URGENT DIRECTIVES
Force the disbanding and
disarming of fascist organizations.
Purge the state apparatus, army,
and police of conspirators.
Create nonpartisan elected bodies
to solidify the People's Front beyond
existing parties.
Support any government that takes
real action against French fascism
based on the People's Front program.
